title: Kingdom Statesmen
description: Dedicated to building godly men through fellowship, accountability, and biblical teaching. We believe that strong men build strong families and communities.

title: Women of Influence
description: Are you a woman with a heart for God and a desire to make a difference? Women of Influence is calling YOU! We are a community of Christ-centered women from all walks of life, united to influence our homes, communities, and the world for Jesus

title: Support Ministry
description: Our support team ensures that every member of our congregation feels seen and cared for through hospital visits, meal trains, and counseling.

title: Worship Team
description: Leading the congregation into the presence of God through music and song. We are a community of musicians and singers dedicated to excellence.

title: Media Team
description: Utilizing technology to spread the Gospel. From sound engineering to live streaming, we make the message of Christ accessible to all.
